_meta.source: MOE, SEAB, ITE, SkillsFuture Singapore public pages
_meta.notes: Plain language definitions. The system runs on acronyms and students are expected to absorb them by osmosis. This file exists so nobody has to pretend they already know.

terms.plain: The system, from 2024, where there are no more Express, Normal Academic and Normal Technical classes. Instead you take each subject at the level that fits you: G1, G2 or G3. You can mix.
The national examination that replaces the O and N Levels. One certificate, listing each subject and the level you took it at. The first cohort sits it in 2027.
Which group you were posted into at the end of primary school, based on your PSLE score. It sets your starting levels in Sec 1. It does not lock them.
The three levels a subject can be taken at. G3 is the most demanding, G1 the most practical. They are levels of a subject, not levels of a person.

terms.full: One language plus four relevant subjects
terms.plain: The aggregate used for Junior College and Millennia Institute admission. Lower is better. It replaced L1R5.

terms.full: English, two relevant subjects, two better subjects
terms.plain: The aggregate used for polytechnic admission. Lower is better.

terms.full: English, Mathematics and three best subjects
terms.plain: The aggregate used for the Polytechnic Foundation Programme and for some ITE entry. Computed at G2 equivalent grades.
A one year foundation inside a polytechnic, taught by polytechnic staff, leading straight into Year 1 of a diploma.

terms.full: Direct Entry Scheme to Polytechnic Programme
terms.plain: A route from secondary school into Higher Nitec with a guaranteed polytechnic place at the end. It is being retired with the 2028 ITE intake, so it will not be available to the first SEC cohort.

An application route at polytechnic and ITE that looks at your interest and aptitude for a specific course, and can give you a place before your results come out. What you have done and can talk about matters here.
The main posting exercise after results, where you rank your choices and are placed by aggregate.
The main ITE qualification. Two years, practical, and recognised by employers straight away.
The level above Nitec. From here the polytechnic route opens, and from there the degree route.
How your results are scored at ITE and polytechnic. For ITE students applying to polytechnic, 2.5 is the minimum from the 2027 intake and 3.5 or above guarantees a place.
The university that NAFA and LASALLE now sit under. Admission leans on portfolio and audition rather than aggregates.
A SkillsFuture route where you are employed and paid while working toward a qualification. Runs at Certificate, Diploma, Post Diploma and Degree level.
Covers up to 90 percent of course fees for adults, including full time diplomas at ITE, the polytechnics, NAFA and LASALLE.
The part of school that helps you think about what comes next. Your school has an ECG counsellor. Talking to them is free and it is the most underused thing in the building.
